discussion_comments.comment_body:
Confirmed and fixed in 4f7129d6b — your suggested route turned out to be the better mechanism, and it actually shrinks this PR.

You're right that the calls in `applyProviderModel` aren't atomic: if the `model` request fails after the `provider` one succeeded, the session has already moved and `onComplete` never fires. Rather than rolling back, the header now consumes `config_option_update`, which the agent emits after every accepted change (in `dispatch.rs`, before responding) carrying the full option set — so a partial failure updates the header just like a full success does. An option missing from the payload leaves the previous value alone, since its absence says nothing about it.

That makes the callback plumbing redundant, so I reverted it: `ConfigureProps.onComplete` goes back to `() => void` (this PR had widened it) and `configure.tsx` is now untouched relative to `main`.

Verified locally: switching provider/model via `^P` updates the header through the notification path.

Fixed. handleCopyMarkdown is now async and awaits navigator.clipboard.writeText(...) before showing the "Markdown copied" toast, so a rejected write (clipboard unavailable / OS denies) no longer reports false success. This matches the existing handleCopyJson and handleCopyFullText handlers. I also wired the dropdown item as onSelect={() => void handleCopyMarkdown()} to handle the returned promise consistently with the sibling "View JSON" action.

**Fixed in cf877cd52a1.** The footer now gates the submit path on a *required* non-OAuth key instead of any config key, so OAuth providers with only optional extras (e.g. GitHub Copilot) keep the OAuth-only footer while xAI still gets the submit path for its required `XAI_API_KEY`. `handleSubmitForm` now validates only the rendered non-OAuth keys, so it can no longer fail on hidden required OAuth fields.
